test_history: 2023 outcomes were previously examined. DKASC 2024 source quality was previously inspected; no untouched-holdout claim is permitted.
author_instruction: Oussi El Houcine only for this draft; funding, competing interests and final approval remain unconfirmed.

point_update.selection: All tree counts and hyperparameters are inherited from each corresponding v28 2021 selection fit. No new duration or parameter search.
point_update.timing: Every training target precedes the first local calendar instant of the prediction month; only predictions with issue >= cutoff are assigned to that month's model.
point_update.population: Same complete-case daylight targets for all policies at a given horizon; do not score missing labels or select dates by error.
point_update.fallback: Reuse previous policy fit if any retained system lacks 100 recent examples; log every fallback.
point_update.scope: Tests updating within LightGBM only; no claim about updated GRU or Transformer families.

calibration_control.primary_comparator: variability_groups versus global_day_night on daylight targets
calibration_control.secondary_comparator: global_day_night versus global_all_hours on daylight targets
calibration_control.previous_day_reference: Same system and target-hour development residual quantiles as v28 smart residual reference, replacing only the point center with previous-day persistence; system fallback below 20 development rows.
calibration_control.fallback: Use the all-hour global correction and explicitly log insufficient groups.
calibration_control.distribution_comparator: Truncated CRPS7 for learned quantiles versus previous_day_residual; raw quantile scores remain distinct from corrected interval scores.

temporal_extension.preprocessing: Same v28 completed-hour, physical-range, reference, and input-window rules; normalize Array 1B by 23.4 kW.
temporal_extension.selection_rule: Use all eligible 2024 daylight targets; no replacement year if results are unfavorable. Report monthly availability even if no complete windows survive.
temporal_extension.interpretation: Additional temporal evaluation on previously source-audited observations. It does not supply an independent campus or certify a fully untouched holdout.

inference.aggregation: Mean absolute losses over seeds, then equally weighted system means; paired synchronous calendar-day blocks.
inference.multiplicity: Holm HAC p-values within each test year, testbed, analysis and metric family; percentile intervals remain pointwise.
inference.limitations: Conditional on fitted seeds, retained observations and retrospective protocol.

release: Code, configuration and aggregate evidence only; raw source records, fitted models and prediction arrays stay in private workspace scratch.
integrity: Preserve v28 artifacts; hash protocol and parent inputs; verify raw/global/group calibration replication; test correction rank, residual fitting scope and monthly cutoff boundaries.
